name: SIAI-Marchetti S-211
summary: Compact Italian jet trainer with a shoulder-mounted wing and a single JT15D turbofan, used by Singapore, the Philippines and Haiti; a few are privately owned in the US.

engines: Single JT15D turbofan fed by side intakes ahead of the wing root
fuselage: Compact fuselage with a long tandem bubble canopy
tail: Swept fin with a small dorsal fillet
Horizontal tail mounted on the fuselage

tellTales: Compact jet trainer with a high shoulder-mounted wing
Tandem canopy and a small turbofan with side intakes

confusedWith.howToTell: The Jet Provost has a low wing and side-by-side seats; the S-211 has a high wing and tandem seats.
The L-29 has a low-mid wing and a pot belly; the S-211 has a shoulder wing.
The SF.260 is a piston airplane with a propeller; the S-211 is a jet.

usCount.source: FAA Releasable Aircraft Database — valid registrations
